test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Bangladesh does not share its boundary with which of the following Indian states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim.**__

Bangladesh shares its borders with the Indian states of **West Bengal, Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Bangladesh is a country in South Asia that shares its border with India to the north, east, and west, Myanmar to the east, and the Bay of Bengal to the south.
 
• Tripura, Assam, West Bengal, Meghalaya, and Mizoram are the Indian state that shares their border with Bangladesh. 
 
• **Dhaka, Rangpur, Khulna, Sylhet, Rajshahi, and Chittagong are the division of Bangladesh that are situated along the India Bangladesh Border.**
 
• Nagaland does not share a border with Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Bangladesh is commemorating its 50th independence day on March 26, 2021.
 
• **Bangladesh was proclaimed as an independent nation by Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and this led to Bangladesh Liberation War when a guerilla war ensued between Pakistan and Bangladesh liberation forces with Indian support.**
 
• It launched a 10-day “golden jubilee” on March 17 with parades, fireworks, and tributes to independence hero Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
